purpose: Freeze the authoritative ownership source for the shared Hero <-> Exclusive Equipment relation layer after reusing the already validated Hero Stage 5-2 source resolution.

admissionOrder.step1: Obtain exactly the frozen 167 equipmentId values whose acquisitionClass is exclusive-equipment.
admissionOrder.step2: Resolve only those 167 equipmentId values to ConfigDataEquipmentInfo.ID.
admissionOrder.step3: Read SkillHero only from those admitted exclusive EquipmentInfo records.
admissionOrder.step4: Resolve SkillHero by exact ID equality against the canonical 267 Hero master.
admissionOrder.generalEquipmentBoundary: No launch, legacy-additional, current-additional, soul-special, or unresolved-no-path Equipment record may enter ownership-source evaluation. General-equipment Hero eligibility is not part of Stage B.

EQUIPMENT_SKILL_HERO.scope: Only the frozen 167 exclusive-equipment IDs admitted before the field is evaluated.
EQUIPMENT_SKILL_HERO.meaning: SkillHero is the canonical owner-Hero ID for an admitted exclusive Equipment record.
EQUIPMENT_SKILL_HERO.join: exclusive equipmentId == ConfigDataEquipmentInfo.ID; ConfigDataEquipmentInfo.SkillHero == canonical heroId
requiredChecks: equipmentId exists in the frozen 167 exclusive-equipment population
exactly one EquipmentInfo record resolves for equipmentId
SkillHero exists in canonical 267 Hero master
no heuristic fallback is used when any check fails

EXCLUSIVE_POPULATION_PATH46.meaning: PathType 46 supports identification of the frozen exclusive-equipment population.
EXCLUSIVE_POPULATION_PATH46.boundary: PathType 46 does not identify an owner Hero and must never create a Hero-Equipment ownership edge.

MISSION_TYPE_77.meaning: For verified SP-Hero fixtures, MissionType 77 Param1 identifies the exclusive Equipment required by that mission.
MISSION_TYPE_77.knownFixture: Hero 6 Leon -> Mission 31186 -> MissionType 77 -> Param1 Equipment 416
MISSION_TYPE_77.boundary: MissionType 77 is retained for B-2 representative cross-validation, not as the canonical 167-record ownership source.

OWNER_NAME_IN_DESCRIPTION.meaning: The prior full validation observed canonical owner-name text in all 167 exclusive Equipment descriptions.
OWNER_NAME_IN_DESCRIPTION.boundary: Description text is never parsed to assign heroId. It may only corroborate an ID-derived relation after the relation already exists.

rejectedSourceKinds.ARMY_JOB_RESTRICTION: ArmyIds / JobIds express equip eligibility semantics, not exclusive ownership.
rejectedSourceKinds.NAME_SIMILARITY: Equipment/Hero names are display or diagnostic metadata only.
rejectedSourceKinds.DESCRIPTION_PARSING: Description strings may corroborate but never create an ownership edge.
rejectedSourceKinds.ICON_OR_ASSET_NAME: Icon and asset filenames are not ownership identifiers.
rejectedSourceKinds.NUMERIC_PATTERN: Equipment ID order, Hero ID proximity, or numeric patterns are forbidden.
rejectedSourceKinds.RELEASE_ORDER: Release chronology or list position is forbidden as an owner resolver.
rejectedSourceKinds.MISSION_TYPE_77_AS_GLOBAL_SOURCE: A verified fixture relation is not generalized into the canonical 167-record source when SkillHero already provides direct complete coverage.

sourceDecision.reason: The field is a direct named ConfigData field, the previous production builder already scoped to exclusive-equipment before resolving SkillHero, and full-population validation resolved 167/167 with no missing IDs, owner errors, duplicate owners, or hard errors.

downstreamRules: B-2 validates representative fixtures against the frozen EQUIPMENT_SKILL_HERO source without searching for an alternate production resolver unless a contradiction appears.
B-3 builds canonical edges only from the 167 admitted exclusive Equipment records and their SkillHero values.
No page pipeline may independently infer ownership after the shared canonical relation is generated.
General Equipment must remain outside all Stage B relation artifacts and validation populations.
completion: B-1 is complete when EQUIPMENT_SKILL_HERO is frozen as the sole production ownership source for the admitted 167 exclusive Equipment records, support/cross-validation evidence is separated from ownership authority, and all heuristic/general-equipment fallbacks are explicitly rejected.
